subject: change marker genotype to missing using info from errorlod

messages.author: d90bad456eabab7d
messages.subject: change marker genotype to missing using info from errorlod
parts:
Dear Rqtl users,

I am doing QTL analysis on a RIL population. In the process checking the genotype data in constructing the genetic map, i calculated the error lod and i got list of 90 genotypes that seem to have >4 LOD score. I would like to change these 90 marker genotpes as missing. Is there R code to do this.


rils_84_impXO <- calc.errorlod(rils_84_impXO, error.prob = 0.01, map.function = "kosambi")
top.errorlod(rils_84_impXO)

example below from the top.errorlod function.

Thanks in advance.

Raj
